method: Direct inspection of all five original PNGs using view_image, including original-detail inspection of the long staging catalogue. Compared every PNG to its ZIP member and manifest SHA256. No authenticated browser actions or source edits by this reviewer.

privacy.scope: Visible contents of these five images only; input-type and capture-guard behavior is reviewed separately in artifact-review.json.

observations: Both onboarding captures show nine-step navigation, the organization form and Next control, with no onboarding runs.

Both theme captures show all seven built-in version3.0.0 theme cards, search/import controls and collapsed preview toggles. Production shows the empty tenant-assignment state; staging shows fixture assignments and historical theme audit entries.
The child capture shows the Ocean Quest background, complete manta mascot in this frame, progress path, badge, map controls and three progress totals. No error page appears.
limitations: The fixed platform header visibly overlaps the upper title area in the platform captures. This review makes no claim that the full application shell is covered or excluded.

The staging assignment controls extend beyond the right edge of the captured region. This single capture does not establish whether those controls are reachable through scrolling. The known expanded catalogue-preview clipping remains unchanged and was not reopened.
The child capture includes a large blank lower area beneath the visible progress totals. The screenshot alone does not establish its cause or full scrolling behavior.
This is a bounded desktop screenshot review, not a new responsive or platform-wide visual audit. The separate fresh full-staging Priority A and seven-theme evidence carries that broader tested scope.
recommendation: No additional blocker established in the reviewed visible regions, and no account email or filled credential field observed. Post-deploy visual evidence is complete for these five screenshots on exact R2 source; final operational observation remains separate.

assignmentReachabilitySourceQualificatio.finding: Assignment forms have no dedicated overflow-x scroll container, and no hidden/clip ancestor through page/main/AppShell/body. Their intrinsic-width 3-5-column grids may overflow the main box; the main-locator screenshot clips at that box. Source therefore supports document-level horizontal overflow rather than an ancestor concealing the actions. Scrolling reachability was not interactively exercised.
